findings.description: Patrick Hoban's wife was named Ellen, and their son Thomas Dee married Bessie Butler at Halifax, Nova Scotia in 1895.

details.son: Thomas Dee, b. about 1874, Halifax; m. Bessie Butler 1895

supporting_sources: Canada, Marriages, 1661-1949 — entry for Thomas Dee and Bessie Butler, 1895, naming the groom's parents Patrick and Ellen
